title: Foodstuffs and Fertilizers Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships Ordinance 1978

sections.shortTitle: Foodstuffs and Fertilizers Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships Ordinance 1978
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS (CANCELLATION OF
AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Foodstuffs and Fertilizers (Cancellation of Authorizations and
Dealerships) Ordinance, 1978.
(2) It extends to the Province
of the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Foodstuffs and Fertilizers Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships Ordinance 1978
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS (CANCELLATION OF
AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978
2. Definitions.‑In this Ordinance, unless. there is anything,
repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) `authorisation' means the
authorisation issued under the West Pakistan Foodstuffs Distribution Order,
1967;
(b) `dealership' means the
authority granted to any person to act as dealer under the Punjab Fertilizers
(Control) Order, 1973;
(c) `Government' means the
Government of the Punjab.

Delegation of powers by Government

4. Delegation
of powers by
Government.‑Government may, by notifica tion in the official Gazette,
direct that the power conferred on it by section 3 shall, under such
conditions, if any, as may be specified in the notification, be exercised by an
officer or authority so notified.

sections.shortTitle: Foodstuffs and Fertilizers Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships Ordinance 1978
sections.description:
Bar of jurisdiction

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS
(CANCELLATION OF AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978
5. Bar of Jurisdiction.‑No Court shall grant any injunction
or make any order or entertain any proceedings in relation to anything done or intended
to be done, in good faith, under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Foodstuffs and Fertilizers Cancellation of Authorizations and Dealerships Ordinance 1978
sections.description:
Protection to persons acting in good faith

ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1978
FOODSTUFFS AND FERTILIZERS
(CANCELLATION OF AUTHORIZATIONS AND DEALERSHIPS) ORDINANCE, 1978
6. Protection to persons acting in good faith.‑No suit, prosecution
or other legal proceeding shall be instituted against any person for any thing
which is in good' faith done or intended to be done under this Ordinance.
